scenarios.name: Parent-accounted remote supervisor on mama survives ambiguous replies and recovers an existing imported generation through its observing host operation
highlights: lost serve reply keeps remote-smama.pending and admission refused (exit 5); next serve publishes complete v2 certificate
host refuses unaccounted relaunch once pools are delivered
launch reply lost after host answered existing(A): candidate G stays counted, admission fails closed
lost disposition reply: still retained; next reconcile imports A bound to operation G and releases G prelaunch
A dies: reclaim via G's receipt = dead-after-start
second route: B imported via H, B dies, plain fm-spawn reclaims B and host accepts --previous B through the H binding; G' started and confirmed once
remote relaunch: stale --expect-generation exits 6; lost relaunch reply reconciled to started, predecessor released old-stopped, no double launch
remote persistence-gated restart: stale projection nudges; answered-in-remote-home request mirrored back authorizes a restart bound to the generation
teardown of both routes releases exactly the live generation (teardown), even with a stale parent projection

scenarios.name: Pooled local supervisor completes relaunch, rollback, persistence-gated restart (incl. generation race) and teardown while preserving generation ownership

isolation: mama: disposable /tmp/fm-lab-sixseat.* root+home, FM_REMOTE_JOB_STATE_ROOT job worker, XDG_CONFIG_HOME-isolated herdr fm-remote server via FM_SSH_BIN shim s1-ssh.sh; operator entrypoint, live fm-remote session (2ndmate-mama) and operator worker unchanged per tripwire; lab removed.
